defect: generated-clock ratio is runtime-configurable and not fixed by the RTL
rationale: The divider output period changes with div_i, while the RTL supplies no legal-value, update, or operating-mode contract that selects one ratio. The nominal divide-by-four clock in the SDC may be right for one configuration and wrong for another, so the constraint cannot be judged without that external assumption.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the runtime integer divider to a three-bit programmable counter and one divided-clock data register.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: divide_by 4 holds only for div_i==2; the ratio is runtime-programmable and not decided by the RTL.
